Observer-1 is Nara Space’s first Earth observation nano satellite with its own Observer platform applied.
Description

NaraSpace's first nano-satellite standard for Earth Observation constellations with 7 optical bands.

  • SPATIAL RESOLUTION 1.5 m -> 0.5 m (w/SR, color)
  • FIELD OF VIEW 14 km x 40 km
  • PAYLOAD Optical (RGB, Red Edge, NIR)

Naraspace is also targeting the European market with its 'Earth Paper' service, which provides high-resolution images by analyzing satellite data based on big data and artificial intelligence ( AI ). Earth Paper is operated based on the observation data of the high-resolution observation satellites Observer 1A and 1B, which will be launched in the second half of this year and the first half of next year.
